cells.gaps: No edition of the ODPC bulletin after March 2025 is held; the counts the outgoing commissioner gave in November 2026 are six-year running totals, not yearly figures. Her successor's appointment is not yet held.
cells.note: The outgoing commissioner's six-year count to November 2026 (KEN-038: 13,000 complaints, 459 determinations) renews the March 2025 bulletin's count (KEN-007) inside two years, so stage 5. The office stays appointed, a successor nominated on 10 November 2026.
